dialogue_texts: What was that? Whose voice was that?
Re-Reimu!? Why are you in the mansion when this is Order territory?
I'm looking to speak with Flandre.
And as the Chief Justice of the Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo Supreme Court, always address me as "Your Honor"!
The Scarlet Devil may be enjoying a day off today, but I'm not going to lead you to her.
In the meantime, my magic will prove you are not welcome!
